script.greeting: Hello. This is an important message from {org_name}.
script.prompt: {notice}. Press one to acknowledge. Press two if you would like us to call you back later. Press nine to stop calls.
script.reprompt: Please press one to acknowledge this message.
script.ack_confirm: Thank you. The message has been acknowledged.
script.ack_call_later: Thank you. We will call you again later.
script.ack_stop: Understood. We will not call you again.
script.ack_unclear: Sorry, we could not record your response. We may try again later.
script.voicemail: Hello, this is {org_name}. We have an important notice: {notice}. Please contact us.
